platform_scope: Linux CT1004 Docker image; syscall.Flock and syscall.Stat_t require adapters for other targets
post_rename_durability: A directory fsync error after rename leaves durability uncertain. The native method returns an error and reloads the visible file while both locks are held; inspect the file before retrying.
remaining_risk: Reload failure after Save failure cannot guarantee that the in-memory database matches disk. The patch reports both errors. Target directory must be trusted and writable, with a regular owner-only user database and lock file.
evidence_scope: Historical local build checkpoint before the subsequent Linux CGO build, candidate image smoke and live rollouts; current deployment and later acceptance are documented in the adjacent README.md and ../README.md
status: patched package compiled as Linux/amd64 test binary with CGO disabled; all focused tests and full affected package passed locally on darwin/arm64 with CGO disabled; no image built or deployed; no remote host changed
focused_upstream_tests: Both native reset and change preserve an onboarding-style atomic edit and disabled user; successful Save replaces the inode, retains 0600, leaves parseable YAML and no temporary file.
Native UpdatePassword starts and holds the provider mutex, then remains pending on the shared flock while an onboarding-style file replacement is made.
A deterministic unsafe-mode Save rejection preserves disk bytes and reloads the old password into provider memory.
Rapid external group and disable edits after a native password save each reload immediately; no watcher cooldown can drop the only disable event.
live_precondition_evidence: Existing sanitized vps-auth-state-20260930.json records user database root-owned 0600 and config directory root-owned 0755; no new live probe.
test_limit: Local tests ran on darwin/arm64 with CGO disabled; the Linux/amd64 test binary was compiled but not executed. No deployable CGO-enabled image was built. No deterministic injection of a failure after temporary-file creation or after rename is included.
